enactment_authority: California Legislature, Civil Code of 1872 (official codification of the entire body of civil law). Authorized by 1870 Stats. ch. 516 creating the Code Commission.
drafters: California Code Commission (1870-1872). Primary sources used: David Dudley Field, Draft Civil Code of the State of New York (1865), §§ 759-762; Robert Pothier, Treatise on the Law of Obligations (French 1761, Evans trans. 1806); Joseph Story, Commentaries on Equity Jurisprudence (1836), §§ 186-206.
amendment_history: None. The text of § 1572 has been stable since 1872 enactment.
text_source_note: The 1872 Civil Code was published as The Civil Code of the State of California (Sacramento: State Printing Office, 1872). The text of § 1572 is reproduced here from the standard codification histories (Deering's Civil Code annotations trace every section back to original enactment; West's Annotated Civil Code § 1572 also carries the '1872' enactment note with no subsequent Stats. cites).

sources_cross_checked: Deering's California Civil Code (annotations showing § 1572 enacted 1872, no subsequent amendments)
